## Total Pipe Length in Plumbing System

**Total: 301.11 meters** (301,106.02 mm measured values from 504 pipe segments)

### Distribution by Building Level

| Building Level | Length | Percentage |
|---|---|---|
| **B01_OKRD** (Basement) | 150.29 m | 49.9% |
| **E00_OKRD** (Ground Floor) | 99.02 m | 32.9% |

input.sql: SELECT DISTINCT Category FROM EntityText WHERE Category LIKE '%WALL%' ORDER BY Category

WITH wall_types AS (
  SELECT EntityIndex, Name FROM EntityText WHERE Category = 'IFCWALLTYPE'
),
wall_materials AS (
  SELECT wt.EntityIndex, wt.Name as WallTypeName, 
         ml.Name as MaterialLayerName, 
         mp.Value as LayerThickness,
         mli.Value as LayerIndex
  FROM wall_types wt
  LEFT JOIN RelationText r ON wt.EntityIndex = r.EntityIndexA AND r.RelationType = 'HasMaterial'
  LEFT JOIN EntityText ml ON r.EntityIndexB = ml.EntityIndex AND ml.Category = 'IFCMATERIALLAYERSET'
  LEFT JOIN RelationText lr ON ml.EntityIndex = lr.EntityIndexA AND lr.RelationType = 'HasLayer'
  LEFT JOIN EntityText layer ON lr.EntityIndexB = layer.EntityIndex AND layer.Category = 'IFCMATERIALLAYER'
  LEFT JOIN ParameterText mp ON layer.EntityIndex = mp.EntityIndex AND mp.Name = 'Ifc:LayerThickness'
  LEFT JOIN ParameterText mli ON layer.EntityIndex = mli.EntityIndex AND mli.Name = 'Ifc:LayerIndex'
)
SELECT DISTINCT WallTypeName, MaterialLayerName, LayerThickness, LayerIndex
FROM wall_materials
ORDER BY WallTypeName, LayerIndex

SELECT DISTINCT e.Name, r.RelationType, e2.Category, e2.Name
FROM EntityText e
LEFT JOIN RelationText r ON e.EntityIndex = r.EntityIndexA
LEFT JOIN EntityText e2 ON r.EntityIndexB = e2.EntityIndex
WHERE e.Category = 'IFCWALLTYPE'
ORDER BY e.Name, r.RelationType

SELECT e.Name as WallTypeName, p.Name as ParameterName, p.ParameterGroup, p.Value
FROM EntityText e
LEFT JOIN ParameterText p ON e.EntityIndex = p.EntityIndex
WHERE e.Category = 'IFCWALLTYPE'
ORDER BY e.Name, p.ParameterGroup, p.Name

SELECT e.Name, p.Name, p.ParameterGroup, p.Value
FROM EntityText e
JOIN ParameterText p ON e.EntityIndex = p.EntityIndex
WHERE e.Category = 'IFCWALL' AND p.ParameterGroup LIKE 'Qto_%'
ORDER BY e.Name, p.Name
LIMIT 100

WITH wall_materials AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT 
    SUBSTRING(e.Name, 1, POSITION(':' IN e.Name) - 1) as WallType,
    m.Name as MaterialName
  FROM EntityText e
  JOIN RelationText r ON e.EntityIndex = r.EntityIndexA AND r.RelationType = 'HasMaterial'
  JOIN EntityText m ON r.EntityIndexB = m.EntityIndex AND m.Category = 'IFCMATERIAL'
  WHERE e.Category = 'IFCWALL'
),
layer_widths AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    SUBSTRING(e.Name, 1, POSITION(':' IN e.Name) - 1) as WallType,
    SUBSTRING(p.Name, 1, LENGTH(p.Name) - 6) as MaterialName,
    CAST(p.Value AS DOUBLE) as LayerThickness
  FROM EntityText e
  JOIN ParameterText p ON e.EntityIndex = p.EntityIndex
  WHERE e.Category = 'IFCWALL' 
    AND p.ParameterGroup = 'Qto_WallBaseQuantities'
    AND p.Name LIKE '%/Width'
)
SELECT DISTINCT
  wm.WallType,
  wm.MaterialName,
  lw.LayerThickness
FROM wall_materials wm
LEFT JOIN layer_widths lw ON wm.WallType = lw.WallType AND wm.MaterialName = lw.MaterialName
ORDER BY wm.WallType, wm.MaterialName

WITH wall_to_type AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT e.Name as WallName, wt.Name as WallTypeName
  FROM EntityText e
  LEFT JOIN RelationText r ON e.EntityIndex = r.EntityIndexA AND r.RelationType = 'IsDefinedBy'
  LEFT JOIN EntityText wt ON r.EntityIndexB = wt.EntityIndex AND wt.Category = 'IFCWALLTYPE'
  WHERE e.Category = 'IFCWALL'
),
materials_per_type AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    wt.Name as WallTypeName,
    m.Name as MaterialName
  FROM EntityText wt
  LEFT JOIN RelationText r ON wt.EntityIndex = r.EntityIndexA AND r.RelationType = 'HasMaterial'
  LEFT JOIN EntityText m ON r.EntityIndexB = m.EntityIndex AND m.Category = 'IFCMATERIAL'
  WHERE wt.Category = 'IFCWALLTYPE'
),
layer_widths AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    wt.Name as WallTypeName,
    SUBSTRING(p.Name, 1, LENGTH(p.Name) - 6) as MaterialName,
    CAST(p.Value AS DOUBLE) as LayerThickness
  FROM EntityText e
  JOIN RelationText r ON e.EntityIndex = r.EntityIndexA AND r.RelationType = 'IsDefinedBy'
  JOIN EntityText wt ON r.EntityIndexB = wt.EntityIndex AND wt.Category = 'IFCWALLTYPE'
  JOIN ParameterText p ON e.EntityIndex = p.EntityIndex
  WHERE e.Category = 'IFCWALL' 
    AND p.ParameterGroup = 'Qto_WallBaseQuantities'
    AND p.Name LIKE '%/Width'
)
SELECT
  mpt.WallTypeName,
  mpt.MaterialName,
  lw.LayerThickness
FROM materials_per_type mpt
LEFT JOIN layer_widths lw ON mpt.WallTypeName = lw.WallTypeName AND mpt.MaterialName = lw.MaterialName
WHERE mpt.WallTypeName IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY mpt.WallTypeName, mpt.MaterialName

WITH wall_with_type AS (
  SELECT 
    e.EntityIndex,
    e.Name as WallName,
    wt.Name as WallTypeName
  FROM EntityText e
  LEFT JOIN RelationText r ON e.EntityIndex = r.EntityIndexA AND r.RelationType = 'IsDefinedBy'
  LEFT JOIN EntityText wt ON r.EntityIndexB = wt.EntityIndex AND wt.Category = 'IFCWALLTYPE'
  WHERE e.Category = 'IFCWALL'
),
materials_with_widths AS (
  SELECT 
    wwt.WallTypeName,
    m.Name as MaterialName,
    p.Name as ParameterName,
    p.Value as LayerThickness
  FROM wall_with_type wwt
  LEFT JOIN RelationText r ON wwt.EntityIndex = r.EntityIndexA AND r.RelationType = 'HasMaterial'
  LEFT JOIN EntityText m ON r.EntityIndexB = m.EntityIndex AND m.Category = 'IFCMATERIAL'
  LEFT JOIN ParameterText p ON wwt.EntityIndex = p.EntityIndex
  WHERE p.ParameterGroup = 'Qto_WallBaseQuantities'
    AND p.Name LIKE CONCAT(m.Name, '%/Width')
),
unique_materials_widths AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    WallTypeName,
    MaterialName,
    LayerThickness
  FROM materials_with_widths
  WHERE WallTypeName IS NOT NULL AND MaterialName IS NOT NULL AND LayerThickness IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT 
  WallTypeName,
  MaterialName,
  CAST(LayerThickness AS DOUBLE) as ThicknessInMeters
FROM unique_materials_widths
ORDER BY WallTypeName, MaterialName

WITH sample_walls AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT 
    wt.Name as WallTypeName,
    e.EntityIndex,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY wt.Name ORDER BY e.EntityIndex) as rn
  FROM EntityText e
  LEFT JOIN RelationText r ON e.EntityIndex = r.EntityIndexA AND r.RelationType = 'IsDefinedBy'
  LEFT JOIN EntityText wt ON r.EntityIndexB = wt.EntityIndex AND wt.Category = 'IFCWALLTYPE'
  WHERE e.Category = 'IFCWALL'
),
first_wall_per_type AS (
  SELECT WallTypeName, EntityIndex
  FROM sample_walls
  WHERE rn = 1
),
wall_materials AS (
  SELECT 
    fw.WallTypeName,
    m.Name as MaterialName
  FROM first_wall_per_type fw
  LEFT JOIN RelationText r ON fw.EntityIndex = r.EntityIndexA AND r.RelationType = 'HasMaterial'
  LEFT JOIN EntityText m ON r.EntityIndexB = m.EntityIndex AND m.Category = 'IFCMATERIAL'
),
widths_per_type AS (
  SELECT 
    fw.WallTypeName,
    SUBSTRING(p.Name, 1, LENGTH(p.Name) - 6) as MaterialName,
    CAST(p.Value AS DOUBLE) as Thickness
  FROM first_wall_per_type fw
  JOIN ParameterText p ON fw.EntityIndex = p.EntityIndex
  WHERE p.ParameterGroup = 'Qto_WallBaseQuantities' AND p.Name LIKE '%/Width'
)
SELECT 
  wm.WallTypeName,
  wm.MaterialName,
  wp.Thickness as ThicknessInMeters
FROM wall_materials wm
LEFT JOIN widths_per_type wp ON wm.WallTypeName = wp.WallTypeName AND wm.MaterialName = wp.MaterialName
WHERE wm.WallTypeName IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY wm.WallTypeName, wm.MaterialName

SELECT DISTINCT RelationType
FROM RelationText
WHERE RelationType LIKE '%Type%' OR RelationType LIKE '%Define%'

SELECT DISTINCT RelationType
FROM RelationText
ORDER BY RelationType

SELECT e.Name, r.RelationType, e2.Name, e2.Category
FROM EntityText e
JOIN RelationText r ON e.EntityIndex = r.EntityIndexA
JOIN EntityText e2 ON r.EntityIndexB = e2.EntityIndex
WHERE e.Category = 'IFCWALL'
LIMIT 20

WITH wall_types_and_widths AS (
  SELECT 
    SUBSTRING(e.Name, 1, POSITION(':' IN REVERSE(e.Name)) - 1) as WallType,
    SUBSTRING(p.Name, 1, LENGTH(p.Name) - 6) as MaterialName,
    CAST(p.Value AS DOUBLE) as Thickness
  FROM EntityText e
  JOIN ParameterText p ON e.EntityIndex = p.EntityIndex
  WHERE e.Category = 'IFCWALL'
    AND p.ParameterGroup = 'Qto_WallBaseQuantities'
    AND p.Name LIKE '%/Width'
),
materials_per_wall_type AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT e.Name as TypeName,
         m.Name as MaterialName
  FROM EntityText e
  LEFT JOIN RelationText r ON e.EntityIndex = r.EntityIndexA AND r.RelationType = 'HasMaterial'
  LEFT JOIN EntityText m ON r.EntityIndexB = m.EntityIndex AND m.Category = 'IFCMATERIAL'
  WHERE e.Category = 'IFCWALLTYPE'
)
SELECT DISTINCT
  wtw.WallType,
  wtw.MaterialName,
  wtw.Thickness
FROM wall_types_and_widths wtw
ORDER BY wtw.WallType, wtw.MaterialName, wtw.Thickness

WITH wall_instances AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    e.Name,
    REGEXP_REPLACE(e.Name, ':[0-9]+$', '') as WallType
  FROM EntityText e
  WHERE e.Category = 'IFCWALL'
),
widths_for_walls AS (
  SELECT 
    wi.WallType,
    SUBSTRING(p.Name, 1, LENGTH(p.Name) - 6) as MaterialName,
    CAST(p.Value AS DOUBLE) as Thickness
  FROM wall_instances wi
  JOIN EntityText e ON REGEXP_REPLACE(e.Name, ':[0-9]+$', '') = wi.WallType AND e.Category = 'IFCWALL'
  JOIN ParameterText p ON e.EntityIndex = p.EntityIndex
  WHERE p.ParameterGroup = 'Qto_WallBaseQuantities'
    AND p.Name LIKE '%/Width'
)
SELECT DISTINCT
  WallType,
  MaterialName,
  Thickness
FROM widths_for_walls
ORDER BY WallType, MaterialName

input.sql:
WITH wall_types AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    SUBSTRING(Name FROM POSITION(':' IN Name) + 1) as WallType,
    COUNT(*) as Count
  FROM EntityText
  WHERE Category = 'IFCWALL'
  GROUP BY SUBSTRING(Name FROM POSITION(':' IN Name) + 1)
),
wall_materials AS (
  SELECT
    w.StepId,
    SUBSTRING(w.Name FROM POSITION(':' IN Name) + 1) as WallType,
    m.Name as MaterialName
  FROM EntityText w
  LEFT JOIN RelationText r ON w.EntityIndex = r.EntityIndexA AND r.RelationType = 'HasMaterial'
  LEFT JOIN EntityText m ON r.EntityIndexB = m.EntityIndex
  WHERE w.Category = 'IFCWALL'
)
SELECT DISTINCT
  wt.WallType,
  wt.Count,
  STRING_AGG(DISTINCT wm.MaterialName, ', ') as Materials
FROM wall_types wt
LEFT JOIN wall_materials wm ON wt.WallType = wm.WallType
GROUP BY wt.WallType, wt.Count
ORDER BY wt.WallType

WITH wall_types AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    SUBSTRING(Name FROM POSITION(':' IN Name) + 1) as WallType,
    COUNT(*) as Count
  FROM EntityText
  WHERE Category = 'IFCWALL'
  GROUP BY SUBSTRING(Name FROM POSITION(':' IN Name) + 1)
),
wall_materials AS (
  SELECT
    w.StepId,
    SUBSTRING(w.Name FROM POSITION(':' IN w.Name) + 1) as WallType,
    m.Name as MaterialName
  FROM EntityText w
  LEFT JOIN RelationText r ON w.EntityIndex = r.EntityIndexA AND r.RelationType = 'HasMaterial'
  LEFT JOIN EntityText m ON r.EntityIndexB = m.EntityIndex
  WHERE w.Category = 'IFCWALL'
)
SELECT DISTINCT
  wt.WallType,
  wt.Count,
  STRING_AGG(DISTINCT wm.MaterialName, ', ') as Materials
FROM wall_types wt
LEFT JOIN wall_materials wm ON wt.WallType = wm.WallType
GROUP BY wt.WallType, wt.Count
ORDER BY wt.WallType

WITH wall_materials AS (
  SELECT
    CASE 
      WHEN Name LIKE '%STB 250%' THEN 'STB 250'
      WHEN Name LIKE '%GK 125%' THEN 'GK 125'
      WHEN Name LIKE '%KS 175%' THEN 'KS 175'
      WHEN Name LIKE '%KS 115%' THEN 'KS 115'
      ELSE SUBSTRING(Name FROM POSITION(':' IN Name) + 1)
    END as WallTypeName,
    m.Name as MaterialName
  FROM EntityText w
  LEFT JOIN RelationText r ON w.EntityIndex = r.EntityIndexA AND r.RelationType = 'HasMaterial'
  LEFT JOIN EntityText m ON r.EntityIndexB = m.EntityIndex
  WHERE w.Category = 'IFCWALL'
)
SELECT
  WallTypeName,
  COUNT(DISTINCT MaterialName) as MaterialCount,
  STRING_AGG(DISTINCT MaterialName, ', ') as Materials
FROM wall_materials
GROUP BY WallTypeName
ORDER BY WallTypeName

WITH wall_materials AS (
  SELECT
    CASE 
      WHEN w.Name LIKE '%STB 250%' THEN 'STB 250'
      WHEN w.Name LIKE '%GK 125%' THEN 'GK 125'
      WHEN w.Name LIKE '%KS 175%' THEN 'KS 175'
      WHEN w.Name LIKE '%KS 115%' THEN 'KS 115'
      ELSE SUBSTRING(w.Name FROM POSITION(':' IN w.Name) + 1)
    END as WallTypeName,
    m.Name as MaterialName
  FROM EntityText w
  LEFT JOIN RelationText r ON w.EntityIndex = r.EntityIndexA AND r.RelationType = 'HasMaterial'
  LEFT JOIN EntityText m ON r.EntityIndexB = m.EntityIndex
  WHERE w.Category = 'IFCWALL'
)
SELECT
  WallTypeName,
  COUNT(DISTINCT MaterialName) as MaterialCount,
  STRING_AGG(DISTINCT MaterialName, ', ') as Materials
FROM wall_materials
GROUP BY WallTypeName
ORDER BY WallTypeName

FROM EntityText roof

  CASE
